There’s many “.exe” if I don’t know what it does it doesn’t really explain much. There’s addons stuff like curseforge or warcraftlog client or weakaura companion.

The .exe suffix is the file extension used for an executable image.

If you write a computer program, in a language like C or C++ it will get compiled into a file containing machine language. The file is called an “object file” and will typically have a .obj suffix.

To become usable it has to be "linked " with what are called “run time libraries” containing routines that interface with the operating system. The linker reads in the .obj files and run time libraries and writes out a the executable image with the .exe suffix.

If you use the “run” command from the command prompt, click on the program’s icon or if you double click the .exe image that will cause the operating systems “loader” to read the file, install it in memory, gather resources like extra memory and it will start your programming running.
